translations.Προβολή προϊόντος «{product_name}»: Παρα: Product view «{product_name}»: Production, Sales, Stock and Sales revenue refer only to this product. Other income and Expenses are shown as general / unallocated and are NOT arbitrarily allocated to the product. Therefore, no misleading «product net result» is calculated.
translations.Μη κατανεμημένα — δεν αποδίδονται στο πρ: Unallocated — not attributed to the product
translations.Μη κατανεμημένα — δεν αφαιρούνται από πρ: Unallocated — not deducted from the product
